entries.title: Lakeview University, Harbor School of Business

roles.title: Master of Business Administration
bullets: Focus: product management and operations; Product Club VP of Events

roles.title: Master of Science in Information
bullets: Coursework: user research methods, data visualization, SQL for analytics

roles.title: Operations Analyst
bullets: Built a weekly **Tableau** dashboard tracking intake and staffing across 6 clinics, cutting scheduling gaps by 18%
Interviewed 25 clinicians to map the intake process and proposed 3 workflow changes the leadership team adopted
Coordinated a 4-person team to move patient scheduling to a new system with no missed appointments in the switch

roles.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Grew add-on sales 12% at a busy counter by recommending options that fit each customer's trip
Trained 5 new associates on the booking system and customer service standards

roles.title: Data Lead, 4-person student team
bullets: Analyzed 2 years of public ridership data in **Python** (Pandas) to find the 5 routes with the steepest decline
Presented route recommendations to city planning staff, who added 2 of them to the next service review

roles.title: Product Designer
bullets: Ran 12 user interviews and turned the findings into personas and a clickable **Figma** prototype
Tested the prototype with 8 students; fixed the 3 biggest usability issues before handing it to the pantry

roles.title: Team Member, 3-person team
bullets: Built a pricing model in **Excel** for a regional grocer and placed second of 14 teams

lines.label: Product & Strategy
lines.text: Product requirements, roadmapping, market sizing, stakeholder presentations

lines.label: Research & Design
lines.text: User interviews, personas, usability testing, Figma
